rationale: The stock is in a strong high-volume downtrend (5.11x relative volume) and trading near session lows at 5.3% of its daily range, but it is currently extended more than 1.5x the 5-minute ATR below both VWAP ($116.74) and the 9-EMA ($116.88). Shorting near the absolute lows offers poor risk-to-reward and adds correlated short exposure alongside existing working orders in NVDA and CBRS, while the recent two-bar pause on 1-minute candles is insufficient evidence of seller exhaustion to justify a long reversal.
